hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In my humble diary, I confess to having stumbled upon a most peculiar scene. Late at night, when the world was asleep, I was scrubbing the hearth in the scullery. The lanterns flickered, casting shadows across the wooden beams, and I heard whispers. There she was, my new companion Clara, her golden hair glinting in the dim light. She was tucking her curls behind her ear, her face a picture of innocent curiosity. The scullery door ajar, the scents of soapy water and wet wool mingled in the air. My breath caught in my throat. What secrets lay hidden in those whispers? Would she confide in me, or perhaps seek solace in my company? Come, dear viewers, follow me as I delve into the secrets of the inn and explore the uncharted territories of the heart. #18thCentury #PeriodDrama #HistoricalRomance #BettyRyal #MaidLife #POV
